meta.task: SIONNA SWEEP - every paper in the local archives that uses Sionna for simulation, classified by WHAT Sionna was used for and whether a TARGET was represented.
meta.tool: PyMuPDF text layer, full document; duplicates removed by SHA1 of the file
meta.rule: Every entry carries (a) the absolute PDF path, (b) the version/stamp found in the PDF, (c) venue AND publication status with the evidence that supports it. Quotes are verbatim from the text layer. Anything not opened in depth is marked MACHINE_CENSUS_ONLY.
meta.headline_distinction: PROPAGATION vs TARGET SCATTERING. Sionna is used for propagation in the overwhelming majority. A target object standing inside the ray-traced scene is rare. An ABSOLUTE target signature in dBsm coming out of a Sionna-based tracer occurs exactly ONCE in this sweep (Ziganshin, EuCAP 2025), and only after the authors added UTD + vertex diffraction and validated against PO/MLFMM solvers.
known_limits: Scope = local archives + a small web extension. This is not an exhaustive census of the Sionna literature.
Venue strings taken from the archive INDEX.md come from Semantic Scholar and are SECONDARY - they are marked as such and must not be cited as verified.
MACHINE_CENSUS_ONLY entries have a verbatim usage quote but their target representation was NOT checked page by page.

headline_findings_ko: 아카이브 고유 PDF 218편 중 Sionna 를 언급하는 것이 140편, 실제로 돌린 것이 137편, 인용만 한 것이 3편이다.
Sionna 버전을 문서에 적은 논문은 18편뿐이고 122편은 적지 않는다 — 스택이 0.8.0 에서 2.0.1 까지 두 번 갈아엎였는데도 그렇다(재현성 공백).
역할 분포: 전파만 118편, 표적을 광선추적 씬 안에 세운 것 6편(중복 1건 제외), 표적 시그니처를 외부 솔버에서 주입한 것 1편, 엔진을 개조한 것 3편, 저자(NVIDIA) 확장 1편.
⭐ Sionna 기반으로 dBsm 을 인쇄한 논문은 1편(Ziganshin, EuCAP 2025)뿐이다. 'physical optics' 라는 말이 나오는 Sionna 논문 자체가 2편이다.
드론이 등장하는 Sionna 논문 다수는 드론이 표적이 아니라 단말·중계기다(2502.10324 는 UAV 138회, 2603.00795 는 42회 — 둘 다 통신 링크).
게재가 PDF 안에서 확인되는 것은 9편뿐이고 128편은 프리프린트 스탬프다 — 이 분야를 '정착된 문헌' 으로 서술하면 안 된다.

taxonomy.PROPAGATION_ONLY: Sionna computes propagation between radio endpoints. No radar target anywhere.
taxonomy.PROPAGATION_ONLY_PLUS_ANALYTIC_TARGET: Sionna gives the background CIR; the target echo is added analytically (point scatterer with an assumed RCS). This is the mainstream h = h_bg + h_target.
taxonomy.TARGET_IN_SCENE: A physical object stands in for the target inside the ray-traced scene (mesh, cube, cuboid) and its echo comes out of the stock interaction set.
taxonomy.TARGET_INJECTED_EXTERNAL: The target signature is computed by a different EM tool and multiplied onto Sionna geometry.
taxonomy.ENGINE_MODIFIED: The paper changed Sionna itself (sampler, diffraction, materials).
taxonomy.ENGINE_EXTENDED_BY_AUTHORS: Extension written by Sionna's own authors.
taxonomy.TOOLING_INTEGRATION / TOOLING_PLATFORM: Sionna wired into another simulator or platform.
taxonomy.COMPETING_ENGINE: A different ray engine that benchmarks against Sionna.
taxonomy.CITE_ONLY: Sionna named in prose or bibliography only; no simulation run.
